idleDecreaseTargetDuration.name: GS_DesertTechHTI.IdleDecreaseTargetDuration
idleDecreaseTargetDuration.limit: Array/reference structure verified; target-duration consumer and units not identified. Do not interpret raw index as duration.

deployedState.spread: Existing weapon source review identifies GBM_NoIncrease_ERG_P00 gated by selector 15cff9ff from bipod-active and mounted WB conditions; IncreasePerShot is zero in this modifier. Source does not prove runtime activation or MP mode availability.
deployedState.consumerLimit: Full exact modifier object GUIDs, fields, values, selector execution, and combination order were not established in this bounded trace. These remain candidates and are not approved for Analyzer import.

analyzerAssessment: A deployed-state comparison could expose per-shot spread growth and candidate recoil/reload changes. The current model has no deployed toggle. MP relevance and specific eligibility require mode/behavior evidence; source names alone are insufficient.

method.reproducibleCommand: $root='../BF6 Datamining/builds/1.4.3.0'; $xml=Join-Path $root 'xml/xml-overlay/Common/GameSetup/Tweakables/GameRemixer/GRX_Weapons.xml'; Select-String -Path $xml -Pattern 'IdleDecreaseTargetDuration|GBM_NoIncrease_ERG_P00|GRM_BipodDeployed|GRM_Mounted|ADSReload|BTM_Bipod'; Select-String -Path (Join-Path $root 'capture/dependency-review-state-2026-09-16.json') -Pattern 'WM_MountedHorizontal_ADSReload|WM_MountedVertical_ADSReload' | Select-Object -First 2; Get-FileHash $xml -Algorithm SHA256
